title: Accept, replace, and measure the gain
brief: Compute the acceptance rate and the residual distribution of a draft model, then write the accept-or-replace rule and check that its output follows the target.
hints: A draft token x is drawn with probability q(x) and kept with probability min(1, p(x) / q(x)), so the chance that x survives is min(p(x), q(x)). Add that up over every token.
The residual is np.maximum(p - q, 0) divided by its sum. When p equals q the sum is 0, and the residual is never used, so return p to avoid dividing by zero.
speculative_accept: draw u = rng.uniform(). If u is below min(1, p[x] / q[x]) return x. Otherwise draw a replacement with rng.choice(len(p), p=residual_distribution(p, q)). Use rng for both draws.
